doc.title: Capper Setup and Torque Check
doc.file: WI-211 Capper Setup and Torque Check.pdf
doc.purpose: Apply caps at the right torque so bottles neither leak nor are too hard to open.

roles.name: Operator
roles.does: Sets up the capper and checks torque.

parameters.quote: 28 mm Lines 1 and 3 (CAP-1, CAP-3) 12 plus or minus 2
38 mm Line 2 (CAP-2), both bottle sizes 17 plus or minus 2
At start-up and every 2 hours: take one bottle from each capping head.

parameters.what: capping heads out of range that stop the line
parameters.quote: Two or more heads out of range: stop the line and call the Maintenance Technician.

rules.statement: The Operator puts product capped since the last good check on hold.
rules.quote: Product capped since the last good check goes on hold as described in QP-315.

rules.statement: The Operator sets the application torque from the table.
rules.quote: Set the application torque from the table below.

unsure.what: The table gives application torque; step 4 has operators measure removal torque
unsure.why: No removal torque range is given, although QP-306 step 3 refers to 'the range in WI-211'
